sn12.52:1.1: viharati upādāniyesu → upādānīyesu (bj) | viharati → viharati tatra kho bhagavā (sya-all)
sn12.52:2.1: mahāaggikkhandho jaleyya → mahā aggikkhandho jāleyya (pts) | jaleyya → jāleyya (bj: PTS) | kaṭṭhavāhānaṁ → So B; S3 -vāhānaṁ; S1 vāhānam, but the two first times the ā after h is erased (pts note) | cattārīsāya → S1-3 cattālīsāya (pts note)
sn12.52:2.3: mahāaggikkhandho → mahā aggikkhando (pts) | evaṁ → evañhi (bj: syā, PTS) | jaleyya → S1-3 jāleyya (See the next sutta 3) (pts note)
sn12.52:4.1: vā → vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṁ (bj, sya-all) | kaṭṭhavāhānaṁ mahāaggikkhandho jaleyya → kaṭṭhavāhānam mahā aggikkhandho jāleyya (pts) | kaṭṭhavāhānam → S1-3 have kaṭṭhavāhānaṁ four times; S1 writing hā (without erasure of ā); S3 ha (pts note)
sn12.52:4.3: aññassa → aññāssa (pts) | anupahārā → anupāhārā (pts) | anupahārā → anupāhārā (cck: pī.) | upādānassa → B aggikhando; S1-3 cupādānassa (pts note)
